manual.scan_id: rx2MRPnes1250pxPDF Double Dragon II - The Revenge.pdf

parse.judge: MiMo as model behind the prompt

notes: Arcade-style controls: A attacks right, B attacks left; A+B jumps.
Punch = attack button in facing direction; Kick = attack button opposite.
Uppercut: chain several punches first; Jump kick: A+B then attack in air.
Weapons (knife, pipe, bomb): walk over to pick up; throw in facing direction.
8 missions in WARRIOR level; 3 lives, 8 energy units per life.

facts.statement: A Button attacks to the right.

citation.quote: To attack to the right, always press the A BUTTON

facts.statement: B Button attacks to the left.

citation.quote: To attack to the left, always press the B BUTTON

facts.statement: A and B simultaneously makes the character jump.

citation.quote: TO JUMP—Press the A BUTTON and B BUTTON simultaneously

facts.statement: Press the attack button in the same direction you face to punch.

citation.quote: TO PUNCH—Press the A or B ATTACK BUTTON in the same direction you're facing

facts.statement: Press the attack button in the opposite direction to kick (back kick).

citation.quote: TO KICK (BACK KICK) —Press the ATTACK BUTTON in the opposite direction you're facing

facts.statement: A+B to jump, then attack button in the air for a jump kick.

citation.quote: press the A and B BUTTONS simultaneously to jump. Then—while in the air—Press the ATTACK BUTTON to kick

facts.statement: Defeat the Black Shadow Warriors and avenge Marion.

citation.quote: they committed the ultimate crime: they gunned down your girl, Marion
Both Billy and Jimmy begin each game with 3 lives
